review_scope: four final 2560x1440 Stage A renders inspected directly at original resolution
positive_findings: scope stayed limited to the reference-supported forward assembly
side openings are real negative space rather than decals
dark barrel is visible through the openings
the rail has a continuous supporting body
Method 03 is materially more disciplined than the failed whole-rifle Method 02
terminal_defects: handguard envelope still reads as a broad beveled rectangular slab instead of the slim machined profile visible in the governed footage
window layout and bridge shapes remain inconsistent with the large rounded-rectangle openings in the governed close crop
rail teeth retain a simple rectangular-block profile rather than a credible MIL-STD-1913 dovetail and recoil-slot profile
FDE material remains chalky and shifts from near-white to dark brown across the same object
side QD cup collapsed to zero triangles and only a small button-like cue remains
open-tine muzzle silhouette is clipped or too small to validate in the review cameras
left, right, and mechanical cameras still crop the assembly endpoints despite the full-assembly framing requirement
reference-match camera does not provide a sufficiently close visual correspondence to the governed onboard crop
boolean and normal treatment produces uneven highlights and soft pinching around openings and rail transitions
next_method_requirement: Use topology-driven hard-surface construction from an explicit cross-section cage, a measured rail profile derived from the accepted rail coupon, and curve-profiled window loops; do not extend this boolean slab with another cosmetic correction.
